'''Jimbo Kinnison''' was a failed [[Jedi/Legends|member]] of<ref name="TRG1" /> the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] of [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-users]]<ref name="CSWE">{{CSWECite|II|150|Jedi Order}}</ref> who was active during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] between the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] and the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]]. They wielded a [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] and at some point accessed the [[Control]] class of [[Force power/Legends|Force abilities]] in conjunction with use of the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side of the Force]]. At one point during the Galactic Civil War, the [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] [[Roark Garnet/Legends|Roark Garnet]] attacked the lightsaber-[[Lightsaber combat/Legends|wielding]] Kinnison while brandishing a [[Club/Legends|club]].<ref name="TRG1" />

==Behind the scenes==
Jimbo Kinnison was mentioned in the [[1987]] [[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game (first edition)|rulebook]] for the first edition of [[West End Games]]' ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]''.<ref name="TRG1" />
